messages:
olivia: Quick kickoff — I'm assembling the release notes and migration guide for the SDK v1.0 renames + anchor reorganize. Need help tightening wording and confirming snippet parity across languages.
zach: I can proof the JS snippets and look for outdated init patterns. Which exact pages are changing?
olivia: Main spots: docs/sdk/js/overview.md, docs/sdk/python/overview.md, whats-new/2026-03.md and the migration guide at docs/migration/sdk-1-0.md. Also a batch of anchors moved under 'API changes' -> we broke some in old redirects.
meera: Heads-up: docs-bot already reported 8 broken anchors in todays run. I attached the list in the PR description (see PR 6092).
odds: (bot) docs-bot: linkcheck report: 8 failed anchors; 3 external 404s; full log in artifacts.
zach: cool — I'll start by replacing deprecated init patterns in JS: `const c = new RedwoodClient()` -> `const client = new Redwood()` and add a short migration note.
meera: For Python, we changed param names (max_len -> max_tokens) and response parsing shape (resp.text -> resp.output.text). Suggest adding a tiny compatibility snippet showing both patterns.
qa-jen: Please tag me when samples land. I'll run a quick smoke on staging Dedicated and hosted. Pay attention to streaming fallback behavior — we saw intermittent partial chunks last week.
olivia: Known issues to include in release notes: streaming deprecation may cause partial chunking in ASIA regions; legacy client alias will remain but be deprecated in one release; netlify redirect lag can keep broken anchors cached for ~30m.
zach: I prefer we update live snippets to the new APIs and keep a short 'legacy shim' callout box in the migration guide rather than duplicating full examples everywhere. Less maintenance overhead.
meera: +1. I'll add a callout block: "If you rely on legacy client, use ClientAlias = Redwood() — removed in 2 releases" (docs snippet).
qa-jen: Also note: SDK wheel name changed so pip install redwood-sdk==1.0.0 may require uninstalling previous package. Add a small troubleshooting blurb.
olivia: Draft changelog bullets so far: - SDK: updated client class and param names (see migration guide)
- Docs: anchor restructure and redirect fixes
- Known issue: embeddings streaming partials in APAC
- Note: legacy aliases will be deprecated
zach: Pushed initial JS snippet updates in PR 6095. Meera, can you add the compatibility example for Python?
meera: On it, PR 6098. I included both code options and a short 'how to test' checklist.
odds: (bot) docs-bot: PR 6095 / 6098 / 6092 linked to changelog draft PR 6101.
qa-jen: Scheduling verification window: Thursday 09:00-11:00 PT. Tag me in the PRs and include staging link + small test plan.
infra: FYI netlify deploys for whats-new are queued; if you update anchors, the redirect TTL may cause a mismatch for ~20-40 min. Consider backfilling a temporary anchor redirect page if you need immediate stability.
olivia: Good call — meera, can you add temporary redirect stubs under whats-new for the top 3 anchors?
meera: Yup, will add `<!-- temp redirect: old-anchor -->` stubs and set netlify redirect entries in PR 6100.
zach: One tiny copy ask: in the whats-new blurb don't say "breaking change" — say "API rename" and link to migration guide. Less alarmist.
olivia: Noted. Will word as: "API rename: client class and select parameter names changed; migration guide and shim included."
qa-jen: After merges, I'll run the smoke tests and post results in this thread. If green, we can ship the changelog.
meera: Merged PRs: 6095 (js snippets), 6098 (py compatibility), 6092 (linkcheck + anchor fixes). PR 6101 is the changelog aggregation.
olivia: Thanks all — I'll publish the draft to the docs review channel and ping docs-approvers. ETA: EOD Wednesday.
qa-jen: :white_check_mark: I'll update this thread with verification results after the run.
meera: small follow-up: added an example test harness snippet for CI: `curl -s $STAGING/docs/whats-new | grep 'migration guide'` — may be crude but catches the main link.
zach: Nice. Closing loop: checklist for release notes publish: 1) merge snippets + anchors 2) QA verification 3) update whats-new draft 4) publish and monitor linkcheck.
olivia: Marking done once QA posts green. Thanks everyone!
